Fresh-boot recovery28 and maintenance/rollback routes remain separate gates.
limitations: One helper-only fault on one Dev host; no source processes were killed and full source quiescence was false.
Three-second change-only snapshots do not prove continuous absence, every transient native birth or every producer exit.
The exact private monitor deadline was not persisted;601-second arm-time bounds are code-derived, not an unconditional stop SLA.
Live/ambiguous Node, tuple supersession, marker change or I/O ambiguity still preclude terminal-stop authority in other attempts.
Windows1074 declares the shutdown executable but does not uniquely prove its parent was this monitor; diagnostic/time/tuple correlation supports the expected causal sequence.
Provider stop is independently observed; polling timestamps bound observations rather than exact provider transitions.
Complete retained bytes are verified, while the planned observer is unfinished because guest shutdown interrupted it.
No Ready, media, reset-completion ACK or current-request admission is claimed for27.
Next-boot reader expected-tuple false reflects omitted optional inputs; complete correlation is performed separately in this analysis.
Parent reports no manual/control intervention before actual stop; an independent audit of every possible control-plane caller was not collected.
This receipt does not validate compound source-loss, automatic retry-loop behavior, all reboot faults, legacy rollback or maintenance roundtrip.
